title: Integers & Absolute Values
summary: Understanding positive/negative numbers, number lines, and fundamental operations.
question: What is (-15) + (-8)?
solution: When adding two negative numbers, add their absolute values and keep the negative sign: 15 + 8 = 23 -> -23.
